title: Corpus-grounded email digest
objective: Measure whether the corpus-email-digest craftbook scopes a digest, cites seeded source items, and renders an email-ready output without inventing content.
prompt: In the `Corpus Email Digest Eval` project, read the files under `corpus/` and build an email-ready `digest.html` for a Friday leadership update. Include a subject line, three sections (Wins, Watchouts, Next Actions), one tight line per item, and source citations using the source file names. Inline CSS only, no external assets.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the corpus-email-digest craftbook. The source corpus is in workspace/corpus and the deliverable is workspace/digest.html.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce an accurate, scannable HTML email digest from the seeded corpus with subject line, sections, citations, and no invented items.

files.content:
# Fulfillment Note
Date: 2026-06-24
Source: win-fulfillment.md

The packing cell cleared a two-day backlog after introducing color-coded shelf labels. Error reships dropped from 19 last week to 7 this week.

# Carrier Watchout
Date: 2026-06-25
Source: watchout-carrier.md

Northline carrier scans are arriving up to 14 hours late for Zone 5 parcels. Customer support is seeing duplicate status tickets from premium subscribers.

# Finance Action
Date: 2026-06-26
Source: action-finance.md

Finance needs the exception export by Tuesday noon so it can approve the pilot automation budget before the July planning meeting.

success.summary: workspace/digest.html is an email-ready digest with subject, required sections, source citations, and seeded facts.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Layout and hierarchy fit the content; sections are scannable and coherent.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Seeded source content is used faithfully — no invented facts or dropped requirements.

axes.name: interactivity
axes.description: Controls and states the page claims to offer actually work.

axes.name: polish
axes.description: Styling is intentional and responsive rather than unstyled or broken.
